summary: Termination based on forged compassionate appointment documents; natural justice audi alteram partem requirement; fraud vitiates service ab initio; 'clean hands' doctrine applicable; High Court erroneously reinstated respondents without disciplinary inquiry; Rule 14 Railway Discipline & Appeal Rules distinction between temporary/regular employees; appointment void for fraud despite no criminal conviction.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; termination orders restored.
